summary.goal: Build the execution engine that takes ForgePlans from Planner and coordinates agents (Workers, Auditors) to produce artifacts. The Forgemaster is a TypeScript service (NOT an LLM) that handles scheduling, workspace management, and coordination.
scope_in: Forgemaster service (TypeScript, state machine, task queue)
SQLite state database for runs and tasks
Git worktree workspace isolation per task
Relay SDK integration for agent spawning

acceptance_criteria.description: Forgemaster receives approved ForgePlan and creates a Run with compiled task DAG
Tasks are scheduled via BullMQ respecting dependencies and concurrency limits
Each task gets isolated git worktree workspace with branch-per-task
Workers are spawned via Relay SDK with MCP tools for reporting
Auditors are dispatched after worker completion to verify acceptance criteria
Human gates pause execution and notify via API/WebSocket
All execution events are captured as trajectories for replay/retrospective
Failed runs can be recovered from checkpoint without re-executing completed tasks
REST API exposes run status, task details, gate approvals, and artifact references
Planner can publish ForgePlan and receive run_id for tracking

observations: Forgemaster is software infrastructure, NOT an LLM agent - deterministic state machine
Separation: Forgemaster coordinates, agents do the actual work
Git worktrees enable parallel execution on same repo without conflicts
Event sourcing via trajectories enables recovery and retrospectives
BullMQ provides reliable task scheduling with Redis backing
MCP is the communication contract between Forgemaster and agents
ForgePlan is the contract between Planner and Forge - keeps packages independent
patterns: Task queue pattern with BullMQ for concurrency control
Event sourcing for durability and audit trail
concerns: Workspace cleanup must handle agent crashes gracefully
Redis is a required dependency - if unavailable, Forgemaster must fail fast with clear error explaining Redis is required

observations: Agents execute in isolated worktrees - limited blast radius
MCP tools control what agents can report - no arbitrary code execution on Forgemaster
Gates provide human oversight for sensitive operations

architect.forgemaster_nature: TypeScript service with state machine, NOT an LLM
architect.storage: SQLite for state, Redis for task queue
architect.agent_spawning: Relay SDK spawn() for task agents

summary.goal: Define core domain entities: Run, Task, TaskAttempt, Artifact, and their state machines

acceptance_criteria.description: Run entity with states: pending, running, paused, completed, failed, cancelled
Task entity with states: pending, queued, running, auditing, completed, failed, blocked
TaskAttempt tracks individual execution attempts with start/end times
Artifact type represents references to produced work (commit, PR, file)
State transitions are validated (no invalid transitions)
ForgePlan and ForgeStep types match Planner contract

summary.goal: SQLite storage layer for runs, tasks, attempts, and artifacts

acceptance_criteria.description: runs table with JSONB for full Run document
tasks table with run_id, status, dependencies as JSONB
task_attempts table tracking each execution attempt
artifacts table with type, reference, and task linkage
Queries for ready tasks (dependencies satisfied), active runs, task history

summary.goal: Redis/BullMQ integration for reliable task scheduling with concurrency limits

acceptance_criteria.description: BullMQ queue for ready tasks with configurable concurrency
Priority scheduling (higher priority tasks first)
Fair scheduling across runs (round-robin between active runs)
Job retry on transient failures
Dead letter queue for permanently failed tasks

summary.goal: Manage isolated git worktree workspaces for each task

acceptance_criteria.description: Create worktree from repo with unique branch (forge/run-X-task-Y)
Write .forge/context.json with task description, criteria, expected artifacts
Configure MCP tools in workspace for agent communication
Cleanup worktree after task completion (configurable retention)
Workspace creation failures throw WorkspaceError with type: disk_full, clone_failed, worktree_failed, permission_denied - no silent fallbacks

summary.goal: Spawn and manage agents via Relay SDK for task execution

acceptance_criteria.description: Spawn worker agent with task prompt, workspace path, MCP config
Receive agent status updates via relay messages
Detect agent completion or failure
Handle agent timeout with graceful termination
Support multiple CLI providers (claude, codex, gemini) via configuration

summary.goal: Dispatch auditor agents to verify worker output against acceptance criteria

acceptance_criteria.description: Spawn auditor after worker completion with artifacts and criteria
Auditor receives read-only access to workspace
Auditor reports pass/fail with detailed findings
Failed audit triggers task retry or escalation
Audit results stored with task attempt

summary.goal: Pause execution at human gates and handle approvals

acceptance_criteria.description: Detect gate steps in ForgePlan
Pause run and mark task as awaiting_approval
Expose pending gates via API
Accept/reject gate via API with optional comment
Resume execution after gate approval
WebSocket/SSE notification when gate is reached

summary.goal: Capture all execution events as trajectories for replay and retrospective

acceptance_criteria.description: Every state transition emits trajectory event
Agent messages and tool calls captured
Trajectory stored with run/task references
Query trajectories by run, task, or time range
Aggregate stats: completion rate, retry rate, average duration

summary.goal: Enable recovery from failures without re-executing completed work

acceptance_criteria.description: Checkpoint run state after each task completion
Recover run from checkpoint on Forgemaster restart
Detect orphaned agents and clean up
Resume paused runs from last known state
Health monitoring for long-running agents

summary.goal: Define MCP tools that agents use to communicate with Forgemaster

acceptance_criteria.description: report_progress tool for status updates
report_complete tool with artifact list
report_blocked tool with reason and suggested change
request_human_input tool for blocking questions
record_decision tool for trajectory decision capture
MCP server runs alongside Forgemaster

summary.goal: REST API for run management, monitoring, and gate approvals

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /runs - create run from ForgePlan
GET /runs - list runs with status filter
GET /runs/:id - get run details with tasks
POST /runs/:id/pause, /resume, /cancel - run control
GET /runs/:id/tasks/:taskId - task details with attempts
POST /gates/:id/approve, /reject - gate decisions
SSE /runs/:id/events - real-time updates

summary.goal: Transform Planner's PlanVersion to ForgePlan and handle handoff

acceptance_criteria.description: Fetch approved PlanVersion from Planner API
Transform to ForgePlan with executable task structure
Map owner_role to agent CLI configuration
Resolve scope to workspace path configuration
Report run status back to Planner for UI visibility

summary.goal: Capture user interactions and build preference model to reduce question fatigue

acceptance_criteria.description: UserTrajectory entity with events, derived preferences, patterns
Questions answered create trajectory events with reasoning
Agents can query preferences before asking questions
findSimilarQuestions for deduplication
Priority scoring: blocking_level×100 + steps_blocked×10 + agents_waiting×15
Check user trajectory before adding to queue
Multiple agents can subscribe to same question
SSE events for new questions and answers

summary.goal: Persistent guardian agents that shadow workers with accumulated context

acceptance_criteria.description: Guardian config in forge-config.yaml
Spawn with Relay shadowOf capability
Project-scoped trajectory persistence
Predefined types: Security, Architect, QA

summary.goal: Prompt agents for structured reflection after task completion

acceptance_criteria.description: Inject retrospective prompt after report_complete
Capture: summary, approach, decisions, challenges, learnings, confidence
Store in trajectory.retrospective

summary.goal: CLI for headless Forge operations and trajectory exploration

acceptance_criteria.description: forge run start/list/status/pause/resume/cancel
forge trajectory show/export/search/decisions
forge gate list/approve/reject
